governing_goal: Determine whether UAOS can discover and evaluate capability gaps without waiting for incidents, and implement the smallest justified architecture that closes any trigger/executor/evidence/promotion gap while preserving governed evolution. Also distinguish repository-enforced controls from native-host paths that are only policy-visible but not physically mediated.
starting_observations: UAOS 2.6.0 already defines outside-in capability discovery and governed self-evolution.
Current GitHub workflows include CI, live integration and domain-health audit but no visible scheduled capability-gap/learning audit.
Current problem_space executable admits a supplied CapabilityDiscoveryAssessment but does not itself acquire sources, schedule audits or create evaluated evolution candidates.
The previous cognition incident showed that prose/method availability is insufficient when the execution chain is not mechanically connected.
external_method_benchmarks: NIST AI RMF ongoing monitoring and periodic review
NASA Technical Assessment continuous technical measures/trend feedback

execution_incidents.observation: The initial durable task-state file was created directly on main before candidate isolation, despite the current UAOS normal material maintenance topology requiring candidate branch -> PR -> checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread.
execution_incidents.immediate_repair: A dedicated candidate branch was created from current main; TASK_INDEX registration and all further audit mutations are being performed on that branch. The direct-main event remains recorded rather than hidden.

execution_incidents.observation: During the selected UAOS maintenance session, final replies drifted from the mandatory inherited-session progress block until the user corrected the omission.
execution_incidents.repository_evidence: config/SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY.json requires the block on every selected-context final response; src/uaos/runtime/finalization.py invokes evaluate_session_progress_response; src/uaos/observability/session_adherence.py fail-closes with MISSING_PROGRESS_REPORT when the gate is invoked.
execution_incidents.implication: The live failure is evidence that this native ChatGPT response path is outside verified repository-controlled pre-send mediation. Do not claim that additional policy prose alone can make the requirement non-bypassable.

next_action: Complete authority-wide scan for proactive learning triggers/executors/evals and separate fixable repository gaps from native-host enforcement limits. Select and implement only interventions that are actually enforceable at the owning layer; preserve host limitations as explicit assurance boundaries rather than pretending policy text is physical enforcement.
